uri.description: {@link ModelRegistry.Entry#uri} of the entry that this card belongs to.

lastUpdatedBy.description: Author of the last update of {@link ModelRegistry.Entry.Card}.

metrics.description:
Metrics associated with this model card.
Key is metric name, value is metric value.

parameters.description:
Parameters associated with this model card.
Key is parameter name, value is parameter value.

plots.description:
Plots associated this model card.
Key is plot name, value is url of a plot.

files.description:
Files associated with this model card.
Key is file name, value is url of a file.

content.description:
Any additional documentation that needs to be part of this model card.
For instance, model developers could use this field to provide flexible documentation such
as intended uses & potential limitations, code snippets for inference etc,.
